# @vllnt/convex-quota

> Scheduled-reset per-subject allowances as a Convex component

`@vllnt/convex-quota` is a publishable Convex component. It targets `convex@^1.45.0`.
It stores one sandboxed table — `allowances` (one row per `(scope, subjectRef, key)` for the
current window: `used`, `limit`, `periodKey`, `windowStartAt`, `windowEndAt`). `consume` adds
`amount` (default 1) if it would not exceed `limit`; `remaining` recomputes the current window
without a write; `refund` subtracts within the same `periodKey`; `eraseSubject` deletes in
bounded batches and reschedules. Windows: calendar (`day` / `week` / `month` + IANA timezone),
rolling (from first consume), epoch (`floor(now / durationMs)`). Time is server-sourced. The host
owns auth, `subjectRef`, `key`, and `limit` (never take limit from the end-user). Distinct from
`@convex-dev/rate-limiter` (silent gate), `@vllnt/convex-metering` (billable usage), and
`@vllnt/convex-wallet` (persistent balance).
